answer_1.quote: We define three challenging tasks: Localization from Embodied Dialog (LED), Embodied Visual Dialog, and Cooperative Localization.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating natural language responses and navigational actions for the Observer agent in the Embodied Visual Dialog (EVD) task, where an AI agent must respond to questions and navigate based on a first-person view.

answer_2.quote: Generated text can be evaluated against human responses using existing text similarity metrics.

answer_4.quote: We collect dialogs on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) - randomly pairing workers into Observer or Locator roles for each episode.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were given written instructions and a walk-through video on how to perform their role. The Locator interface also included the option to make their prediction by clicking a spot on the top-down map - terminating the dialog.
